think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s valid range and default. 2) Check whether any specific numeric value (e.g., -1, 0) is documented to switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (such as ‘auto’, ‘unlimited’, or ‘disable feature’) rather than just ‘less/more’. 3) If such a mode-switch value exists, classify as a special knob and record that value; otherwise classify as non-special.
